CDC restructured its case-data categories between the Sept 1 and Sept 8 updates, so this total is not directly comparable to the prior 31,950 figure — much of the apparent shift reflects cases moving between the 'pending classification' and 'pending interview' buckets, not a real change in growth rate. Food-safety attorney Bill Marler's independent fifty-state tally stood at roughly 33,525 as of Sept 4, even as CDC said Sept 4 it is reducing update frequency and only 13 of the 41 states that ever published case data still maintain a public page.
